ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity (black) pixels dominate over 95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are restricted to a singular focal patch near the median notch base and distal tip colonies.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of contiguous low-intensity black pigmentation; a small irregular high-contrast white patch is located at the lower-central region adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a visible interior angle approximately between 45 and 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible across the entire trailing edge of both lobes, ranging in pixel amplitude from approximately 5 to 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the upper boundary of both lobes tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacles) localized exclusively at the distal tips (left and right) and outer trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcareous barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes; visible white scarring/mottling at the junction of the lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Water droplets and spray partially occluding the ventral surface along the lower horizontal line of the fluke.
